name: manga-lab-app
description: Local-first desktop reader that translates raw manga, manhwa and webtoons to Simplified Chinese.
author: Contributors

scripts.smoke:detect-worker: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-electron.mjs detect-worker
scripts.smoke:overlay: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-electron.mjs overlay
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run fetch:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run fetch:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win
